characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: Setup: After placing forces, choose 1 enemy ship and assign the Listening Device condition to it.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: During the End Phase, enemy ships at range 1-2 cannot remove jam tokens.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: If a friendly ship at range 0-3 would gain a focus token, it may gain 1 evade token instead.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: At the start of the Activation Phase, you may spend 3 [charge]. During this phase, each friendly ship reduces the difficulty of its red maneuvers.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: At the start of the Engagement Phase, if you are damaged, you may perform a red [reinforce] action.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: During the System Phase, you may spend 2 [charge]. If you do, choose the [1 left bank], [1 straight], or [1 right bank] template. Each friendly ship may perform a red [barrel roll] action using that template.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: Decrease the difficulty of your bank maneuvers.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: During the End Phase, if you are damaged and not shielded, you may roll 1 attack die to recover 1 shield. On a [hit] result, expose 1 of your damage cards.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: During the System Phase, you may choose any number of enemy ships beyond range 1. If you do, spend that many [force] to flip each chosen ship's dial faceup.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: Action: Choose 1 enemy ship at range 1-3. If you do, spend 1 [force] to assign the I'll Show You the Dark Side condition to that ship.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: After you perfrom an [evade] action, gain additional evade tokens equal to the number of enemy ships at range 0-1.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: Setup: Lose 1 [charge]. After a friendly ship at range 0-3 is dealt 1 damage card, recover 1 [charge]. While you perform an attack, you may spend 2 [charge] to change 1 [focus] result to a [critical] result.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: While you coordinate, you can choose friendly ships beyond range 2 if they have [calculate] on their action bar. After you perform the [calculate] or [coordinate] action, gain 1 calculate token.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: While you defend or perform an attack, you may spend 1 of your results to acquire a lock on the enemy ship.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: While you perform a white [coordinate] action, you may treat it as red. If you do, you may coordinate up to 2 additional ships of that same type, and each ship you coordinate must perform the same action, treating that action as red.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: At the end of the Engagement Phase, each enemy ship at range 0-1 that is not stressed gains 1 stress token.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: During the Activation or Engagement Phase, after an enemy ship in your [front arc] at range 0-1 gains a red or orange token, if you are not stressed, you may gain 1 stress token. If you do, that ship gains 1 additional token of the type that it gained.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: Before a ship at range 0-2 rolls attack or defense dice, if all of your [force] are active, you may spend 1 [force] and name a result. If the roll does not contain the named result, the ship must change 1 die to that result.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: Setup: Equip this side faceup. After you defend, if the attacker is at range 0-2, you may spend 1 [force]. If you do, the attacker gains 1 stress token. During the End Phase, you may flip this card.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: After you perform a purple [coordinate] action, the ship coordinated gains 1 stress token. Then it gains 1 focus token or recovers 1 [force].

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: While you defend, after the Neutralize Results step, if there are 2 or more [hit]/[critical] results, you may spend 1 [charge] to cancel 1 [hit] or [critical] result. After a friendly ship is destroyed, recover 1 [charge].

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: After a friendly ship reveals its dial, you may spend 1 [force]. If you do, the chosen ship reduces the difficulty of that maneuver.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: Before you engage, you may choose another friendly ship at range 1-2. You may transfer to that ship 1 token of a type that ship does not have. That ship may transfer 1 token to you of a type you do not have.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: Setup: Before placing forces, you may spend 3-5 [charge]. If you do, choose another friendly ship and assign the It's the Resistance condition to it.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: After you reveal your dial, you may set your dial to a basic maneuver of the next higher speed. While you execute that maneuver, increase its difficulty.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: While you have 2 or fewer stress tokens, you can perform [reinforce], [coordinate], and [jam] actions, even while stressed. While you perform a white [reinforce], [coordinate], or [jam] action, if you are stressed, treat that action as red.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: At the end of the Activation Phase, you may choose 1 friendly ship at range 1-2. If you do, transfer 1 calculate token to that ship. If your revealed maneuver is blue, you may transfer 1 focus token instead.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: After you fully execute a blue maneuver, remove all of your stress tokens.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: While you defend, if you are calculating, you may reroll 1 defense die. After you perform a [calculate] action, gain 1 calculate token.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: At the start of the Engagement Phase, you may spend 1 [force] to rotate your [turret arc] indicator.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: After you perform a [front arc] attack, you may perform a bonus primary [rear arc] attack.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: If you would drop or launch a device, you may use a template of the same bearing with a speed 1 higher or lower.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: After you perform a primary attack, you may perform a bonus [turret arc] attack using a [turret arc] you did not already attack from this round.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: Before you engage, you may perform a red [focus] action.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: While you perform an attack, you may spend 1 [force] to change 1 of your [focus] results to a [critical] result.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: After you perform a primary attack, you may spend 1 [force] to perform a bonus [turret arc] attack from a [turret arc] you have not attacked from this round. If you do and you are stressed, you may reroll 1 attack die.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: After you perform a primary attack that misses, if you are not stressed, you must receive 1 stress token to perfrom a bonus primary attack against the same target.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: While you perform an attack, you may change 1 [hit] result to a [critical] result for each stress token the defender has.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: During the End Phase, you may rotate your [turret arc] indicator.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: During the Engagement Phase, at initiative 7, you may perform a [turret arc] attack. You cannot attack from that [turret arc] again this round.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: After you perform a primary attack, if you are focused, you may perform a bonus [turret arc] attack against a ship you have not already attacked this round.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: After you defend, if the attacker is in your firing arc, you may spend 1 [charge]. If you do, roll 1 attack die unless the attacker chooses to remove 1 green token. On a [hit] or [critical] result, the attacker suffers 1 [regular] damage.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: While you perform an attack, you may spend 1 [charge] to change 1 [hit] result to a [critical] result. While you defend, if your [charge] is active, the attacker may change 1 [hit] result to a [critical] result.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: While you perform a [turret arc] attack, after the Modify Defense Dice step, the defender removes 1 focus or calculate token.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: While you perform a primary [front arc] attack, if your [turret arc] is in your [front arc], you may roll 1 additional attack die. After you perform a primary [front arc] attack, if your [turret arc] is in your [rear arc], you may perform a bonus primary [turret arc] attack.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: While you defend or perform an attack, if the enemy ship is in your [turret arc], you may spend 1 [force] to change 1 of your blank results to an [evade] or [hit] result.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: While you defend or perform a primary attack, if the enemy ship is in your [front arc], you may add 1 blank result to your roll (this die can be rerolled or otherwise modified).

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: After you perform a primary attack, you may drop 1 bomb or rotate your [turret arc]. After you are destroyed, you may drop 1 bomb.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: After you perform an attack that missed, if 1 or more [hit]/[critical] results were neutralized, the defender gains 1 strain token.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: While another friendly ship performs a primary attack, if the defender is in your firing arc, you may spend 1 [charge]. If you do, the attacker rolls 1 additional die, to a maximum of 4. During the System Phase, you may gain 1 disarm token to recover 1 [charge].

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: After you execute a maneuver, you may spend 1 [force] and choose a friendly ship at range 1-3 in your firing arc. If you do, it may perform a red [focus] action, even while stressed.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: After you reveal your dial, you may spend 1 [charge] and gain 1 disarm token to recover 1 shield.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: After you reveal your dial, you may spend 1 [charge] and gain 1 disarm token to recover 1 shield.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: You can maintain up to 2 locks. Each lock must be on a different object. After you perform a [lock] action, you may acquire a lock.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: Action: Spend 1 [charge] to repair 1 facedown damage card. Action: Repair 1 faceup Ship damage card.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: Action: Spend 1 [charge] to repair 1 facedown damage card. Action: Repair 1 faceup Ship damage card.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: Decrease the difficulty of your speed 1-2 basic maneuvers ([left turn], [left bank], [straight], [right bank], [right turn]).

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: Action: Spend 1 non-recurring [charge] from another equipped upgrade to recover 1 shield. Action: Spend 2 shields to recover 1 non-recurring [charge] on an equipped upgrade.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: After you fully execute a maneuver, if you have not dropped or launched a device this round, you may drop 1 bomb.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: While you perform an attack against a defender in your [front arc], you may spend 1 [charge] to reroll 1 attack die. If the rerolled result is a [critical] result, suffer 1 [critical] damage.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: You can perform attacks against friendly ships.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: Before you execute a blue maneuver, you may spend 1 [charge] to perform a [barrel roll] or [boost] action.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: Before you execute a blue maneuver, you may spend 1 [charge] to perform a [barrel roll] action.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: While a ship you are locking performs an attack, you may choose 1 attack die. If you do, the attacker rerolls that die.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: While you defend, you may spend your lock on the attacker to reroll any number of your defense dice.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: Before you activate or engage, you may spend 1 [charge] to ignore obstacles until the end of this phase.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: After you fully execute a red maneuver, you may spend 1 [charge] to perform an action, even while stressed.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: After you fully execute a red maneuver, if there is an enemy ship in your [bullseye arc], gain 1 calculate token.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: Before you execute a basic maneuver, you may spend 1 [charge]. If you do, while you execute that maneuver, reduce its difficulty.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: While you perform an attack, you may spend 1 evade token to change 1 [focus] result to a [hit] result.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: After you reveal your dial, you may set your dial to a maneuver of the same bearing of a speed 1 higher or lower.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: Setup: Equip this side faceup. After you execute a maneuver, you may spend 1 [charge] to perform a red [evade] action, even while stressed. During the End Phase, if this card has 0 active [charge], flip it.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: After you execute a maneuver, you must choose a ship at range 0-1. It gains 1 jam token.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: Attack: If this attack hits, spend 1 [hit] or [critical] result to cause the defender to suffer 1 [regular] damage. All remaining [hit]/[critical] results inflict ion tokens instead of damage.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: During the System Phase, you may choose 1 ship at range 0-1 and look at its dial. If you spend 1 [force], you may choose a ship at range 0-3 instead.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: When you perform a special attack, you may spend 1 [force] to ignore the [focus] or [lock] requirement.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: At the start of the Engagement Phase, you may spend 1 [force]. If you do, engage at initiative 7 instead of your standard initiative value this phase.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: Before you activate, you may spend 1 [force] to perform a [barrel roll] or [boost] action. Then, if you performed an action you do not have on your action bar, suffer 1 [regular] damage.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: After you declare an attack, if the defender is in your [bullseye arc], you may spend 1 [force]. If you do, during the Roll Defense Dice step, the defender cannot roll more defense dice than the number of your [hit]/[critical] results.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: After you suffer 1 or more damage, recover that many [force].

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: You cannot coordinate limited ships. While you perform a purple [coordinate] action, you may coordinate 1 additional friendly non-limited ship of the same type. Both ships must perform the same action.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: While you defend, if you are not in the attacker's [bullseye arc], you may spend 1 [force] to change 2 of your [focus] results to [evade] results.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: After an enemy ship executes a maneuver, you may spend 1 [force] to perform this attack against it as a bonus action. Attack: You may change 1 [focus] result to a [hit] result; your dice cannot be modified otherwise.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: After you reveal your dial, you may spend 1 [force] to perform a [barrel roll] or [boost] action. Then, if you performed an action you do not have on your action bar, gain 1 strain token. If you do, you cannot perform another action during your activation.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: While you have 2 or fewer stress tokens, you can perform [barrel roll] and [boost] actions even while stressed.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: While you coordinate or jam, if you have a lock on a ship, you may spend that lock to choose that ship, ignoring range restrictions.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: After an enemy ship locks you, if you are not in that ship's [bullseye arc], that ship gains 1 stress token.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: While a friendly ship at range 1-2 performs an attack against a target you have locked that ship ignores the [lock] attack requirement.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: Setup: Before placing forces, you may choose a number between 0 and 6. Treat your initiative as the chosen value during Setup. After Setup, assign 1 focus or evade token to each friendly ship at range 0-2.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: While you perform an attack, you may spend 1 focus token to change 1 of your blank results to a [hit] result.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: While you fully execute a red maneuver, before the Check Difficulty step, you may perform 1 action.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: While a friendly shp at range 0-3 performs a primary attack against a defender in its [bullseye arc], if there are 2 or fewer attack dice, it may spend 1 calculate token to add 1 [hit] result.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: During the End Phase, you may choose up to 3 friendly ships at range 0-3. If you do, each of these ships does not remove 1 calculate token.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: While a friendly shp at range 0-3 defends, it may spend 1 calculate token. If it does, add 1 [evade] result unless the attacker chooses to gain 1 strain token.

characteristics.name: Ability
characteristics.$text: After a friendly ship at range 0-3 with [calculate] on its action bar is destroyed, each friendly ship at range 0-3 with [calculate] on its action bar gains 1 calculate token.
